A 600 g ingot of the (CoCrFeMnNi)95.2Al3.2Ti1.6 HEA was produced by induction melting. ... The alloy was melted at 1600 ◦C for 1 h to attain homogeneous composition and solidified in a quartz tube with a diameter of 7.8 mm.
After casting, the ingot was homogenized at 1000 ◦C for 8 h under Ar atmosphere, and water quenched.
Subsequently, the alloy was cold-rolled to a thickness reduction of 80%. The thickness of the material was reduced from 7.8 mm to 1.5 mm upon cold-rolling.
The cold-rolled material was annealed at temperatures ranging from 600 ◦C to 1000 ◦C for 1 h under Ar atmosphere.
